questions.q_en: A and B start a business. A invests 33(1/3)%, of the total capital and B invests the remaining. If the total profit at the end of the year is ₹ 1,62,000, then B's share (in ₹) is:
questions.solution_en:
33(1/3)=33+ (1/3) =100/3

Let the total investments of A and B together = ₹ a

Then, A's investment = (100/3)% of a = ₹ a/3

And B's investment = a - a/3 = ₹ 2a/3

Since A and B invested for the same period, so

Profit ratio = investment ratio = A: B = (a/3): (2a/3) = 1: 2

Total profit earned = ₹ 1,62,000

Therefore, share of B in profit = 162000 * 2/(1 + 2) = ₹ 108000

questions.q_en: The base radius of a circular cone and its height are in the ratio of 13: 7. If the sum of its radius and height is 40 cm, then find the volume (in cm3) of the cone.
questions.solution_en:
Let the radius and height of cone be 13X and 7X respectively.

Given,

13X + 7X = 40

20X = 40

X = 2

So, radius = 13X = 13*2 = 26 cm and

Height = 7X = 7*2 = 14 cm

Volume of cone = (1/3) * π * 26 * 26 * 14

= (1/3) * (22/7) * 676 * 14

= 9914.66 cm3

questions.q_en: A can complete a piece of work alone in 200 days, while B can complete the same piece of work alone in 100 days. In every three-day cycle, both A and B work on day 1, only A works on day 2, and only B works on day 3. This cycle continues till the work is completed. How many days in all does it take the duo to complete the work?
questions.solution_en:
Total work = LCM of 200 and 100 = 200 units

Efficiency of A = 200/200 = 1 unit/day

Efficiency of B = 200/100 = 2 units/day

Total work in 3 days = (1 + 2) + 1 + 2 = 6 units

Total work in 99 days = 33 * 6 = 198 units

Remaining = 200 - 198 = 2 units

Total = 99 + 2/3 = 99(2/3) days

questions.q_en: If a/b + b/c + c/a = 28 and b/a + c/b + a/c = 7, then find the value of a2/b2 + b2/c2 + c2/a2 ?
questions.solution_en:
Let a/b = x, b/c = y and c/a = z

xyz = 1 (as the products of the ratios cycle back to 1)

x + y + z = 28............(i)

1/x + 1/y + 1/z = 7

(yz + zx + xy)/xyz = 7

yz + zx + xy = 7........(ii)

a2/b2+ b2/c2 + c2/a2 = x2 + y2 + z2

x2 + y2 + z2 = (x + y + z)2 - 2(xy + yz + zx)

putting values from (i) and (ii) we get,

x2 + y2 + z2 = (28)2 - 2(7)

x2 + y2 + z2 = 784 - 14

a2/b2 + b2/c2 + c2/a2 = 770

questions.q_en: In a research lab, five senior scientists, each equally efficient, can complete a complex analysis in 10 days. After 5 days, two juniors join at half a senior's efficiency each, and one senior leaves. How many days from that point are required to finish?
questions.solution_en:
Total work = 5 seniors X 10 days = 50 senior-days

Work done in first 5 days = 5 seniors X 5 days = 25 senior-days

Remaining = 50 - 25 = 25 senior-days

New team efficiency = 4 seniors X 1 + 2 juniors X 0.5 = 4 + 1 = 5 senior-equivalent units per day

Days needed = 25 ÷ 5 = 5 days

questions.q_en: Three pipes A, B and C can fill a tank in 14 hours, 16 hours and 28 hours respectively. If pipe A and B together are opened for 3 hours, then in how much time will pipe C fill the remaining portion of the tank?
questions.solution_en:
A = 14 hours

B = 16 hours

C = 28 hours

Part of tank filled by pipe A and B together = 3 * ((1/14) + (1/16)) = 45/112

Remaining part = 1 - 45/112 = 67/112

Then, time taken by pipe C to fill the remaining part = (67/112) * 28 = 16.75 hours

questions.q_en: The angle of elevation of a bird from a point 50 m above a lake is 30 and the angle of depression of its reflection in the lake is 60. What is the height at which the bird is located?
questions.solution_en:
We have drawn the figure according to the given information in the question.

Here E is the location of the bird. So the total height of the bird from sea level is

BE = BC + CE = 50 + h

Here AB represents sea level. Now BE = BF

because the reflection of the bird will be at the same depth as its height from the sea level.

Now in triangle DEC, tan 30° = h/DC ⇒ DC = h√3 .. (1)

Now in triangle DFC, tan 60° = (50 + (50+h))/DC or DC = (100 + h)/√3 ..(2)

From equation (1) and (2)

3h = 100 + h ⇒ 2h = 100

⇒ h = 50m

So the height of the bird = BE = 50 + h = 100m

questions.q_en: Ronak and Riya can do a work in 12 and 18 days, respectively. They worked together for six days and then Ronak left. Find the time taken by Riya to complete the work.

Efficiency of Ronak = 36/12 = 3

Work done by Ronak and Riya in 6 days = 6(3 + 2) = 30 units

Remaining work = 36 - 30 = 6 units

Time taken by Riya to complete remaining work = 6/2 = 3 days

questions.q_en: A cistern can be filled by two pipes in 8 minutes and 10 minutes, separately. Both the pipes are opened together for a certain time, but due to an obstruction, only 5/8 of the full quantity of water flowed through the former pipe and 3/5 through the latter pipe. However, the obstruction was suddenly removed, and the cistern was filled in 3 minutes from that moment. How long did it take before the full flow began?
questions.solution_en:
Effective rates of pipes under obstruction:

For Pipe 1 (5/8 of full flow):

Rate = (5/8) X (1/8) = 5/64

For Pipe 2 (3/5 of full flow):

Rate = (3/5) X (1/10) = 3/50

Total rate of work under obstruction = 5/64 + 3/50

Take LCM of 64 and 50 = 1600:

5/64 = 125/1600, and 3/50 = 96/1600

Total rate = 125/1600 + 96/1600 = 221/1600

Work done after obstruction is removed:

Full flow rate of Pipe 1 = 1/8 and Pipe 2 = 1/10:

Total rate of full flow = 1/8 + 1/10

Take LCM of 8 and 10 = 40:

1/8 = 5/40, and 1/10 = 4/40

Total rate = 5/40 + 4/40 = 9/40

Time taken after full flow began = 3 minutes.

Work done in 3 minutes = Rate X Time:

Work = (9/40) X 3 = 27/40

Work done before obstruction was removed:

Total work = 1 (full cistern).

Work done before = Total work - Work done after obstruction was removed:

Work done before = 1 - 27/40 = 13/40

Time taken before obstruction was removed:

Work = Rate X Time

Time = Work / Rate

=> (13/40) ÷ (221/1600)

Convert division into multiplication:

Time = (13/40) X (1600/221)

=> (13 X 1600) / (40 X 221) = 20800 / 8840 or 2(6/17) minutes
